verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents running parallel agents with one agent per workspace, all supervised from one tab, and exposes each workspace as its own OpenAI-compatible model (docs-36, docs-33). Custom agents can also be added as selectable models (docs-26), and channels are shared spaces where specific AI models join conversations (docs-9). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-agent system prompts, explicit rules for routing channels or conversations to a designated agent, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-agent setups.
